messages:
Maya (PM): Heads up — BigRetail just asked to onboard their fine-tuned Llama variant and wants it pinned to a specific model sha for at least 3 months. They need p95 latency <= 120ms for 512 tokens and strong rerank parity with our reference. Do we have a fast path to evaluate + propose a migration runway?
Raj (Eng): short answer: yes but caveats. If it's a q4fp16 quantized variant we need a kernel perf pass. Also need to confirm KV cache behavior for long chats. Can we get sample traffic + eval set?
Sam (CSE): I'll ask BigRetail for the eval subset and 48h traffic dump. They said they can tolerate a 2-week grace period during migration but want the pin until we validate.
Ana (ML): For onboarding checks I propose: 1) quality: >=95% pass on our rerank benchmark or max 2% relative drop vs current prod; 2) hallucination rate <= baseline on named-entity tests; 3) latency p95 within 1.3x of our verified profile; 4) embedding similarity delta < 0.02. If any fail, block pin or require compensating config.
Leo (SRE): infra note: Dedicated pools are fine but we'll need to reserve capacity for the pin window. If we grant a pin TTL we should attach a rollback SLA and autoscale guardrails. Also: canary windows need an ops calendar slot.
Raj (Eng): Proposal for pin handling: - Soft pin: enforce model version for customer routing but allow system fallback to a vetted variant on overload. - Hard pin: route always to requested sha, we reserve capacity and add higher on-call cost. Soft pin is default for onboarding unless customer pays for reserved capacity.
Maya (PM): That maps to our negotiation path. BigRetail has asked for a hard pin but hasn't signed a reserved capacity contract yet. Sam, can you push for a 3mo reserved commit or we offer soft pin + 90d TTL?
Sam (CSE): I'll push for reserved commit. If they won't commit, we can offer 90d soft pin with automatic unwind unless they sign. They prefer predictability; might accept a discount for reserve.
Ana (ML): On the benchmark run: I'll queue model against our standard onramp suite. Targets: exact-match QA, rerank AUC, token-level perplexity on their domain, and the latency profile. Suggest gating thresholds in PRD: quality_gate=pass, latency_gate=warn/block if >1.5x.
Raj (Eng): Ops note: Need to add a quick perf matrix in the catalog: {model_sha, quant, fp_type, p95_512, memory, kv_behavior}. That helps sales and CS understand tradeoffs.
Maya (PM): Agree. Action items: Ana run onramp eval (ETA 48h), Raj add perf matrix entry and check kernel compatibility (48h), Leo reserve tentative pool and block canary calendar slot (3 business days), Sam negotiate reserve + get eval data (24h).
Leo (SRE): Also schedule a rollback SLA: canary 5% for 6h -> 25% for 12h -> 100% with quality monitors. If rerank drift > 2% or error rate spike >0.5%, auto rollback.
Raj (Eng): sample rollout config (for ops):
```
rollout:
  phases:
    - pct: 5
      duration: 6h
      monitors: [latency_p95, rerank_delta, 5xx_rate]
    - pct: 25
      duration: 12h
      monitors: [latency_p95, rerank_delta]
    - pct: 100
      duration: 24h
      monitors: [latency_p95, rerank_delta, error_rate]
fallback_policy: soft-fallback-enabled: true
```
Maya (PM): Pin-exception decision heuristics we discussed: require either (A) reserved capacity + signed SLA for hard pin, or (B) soft pin with 90d TTL + weekly eval reports for non-contract customers. Also any pin >90d requires exec approval.
Ana (ML): Addendum: for safety, if a pinned model shows quality regression on production prompts but passes synthetic eval, trigger an emergency rollback and an extended audit. Can't rely just on offline suites.
Sam (CSE): Customer negotiation update: BigRetail ok with 90d soft pin if we provide a transparent migration plan and API stability guarantees. They prioritized reliability over an immediate hard pin.
Maya (PM): Decision: Move forward with soft pin + 90d TTL, run full onramp eval, schedule canary, and present reserved capacity offer. If BigRetail signs reserves within 14 days we upgrade to hard pin and reserve capacity. Owner: Maya to track and Raj to implement routing rules.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 1788889900 (5% traffic) — will post progress updates and alerts to #eng-runtime during the window.
Leo (SRE): I'll set up the alert and the auto-rollback thresholds. Also will add cost impact estimate for the reserved option.
Raj (Eng): One more cross-cutting ask: add a catalog flag "pin_ttl" and "pin_type" and show in console so PMs/CS can see pin state. I can prototype API by EOD.
Maya (PM): Great — capture notes in the onboarding ticket and we'll review in Monday roadmap sync. Thanks, team :thumbsup:
